prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Monochrome Signal: page #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #494949, secondary surface #E8E8E8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Work Sans and reading text in Work Sans; single-family hierarchy through weight and size. Composition: Aligned comparison rows, sticky labels, compact toolbar, no hero. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
